item.title: Elkins Corridor Medical Center cuts ribbon on expanded rapid care facility
item.description: WVU Medicine United Hospital Center Cut the ribbon Thursday on its expanded rapid care facility and community pharmacy at the Elkins Corridor Medical Center.

item.title: University High School hosts WVU STEAM-TACULAR program
item.description: High school students in Morgantown learned how to build miniature space rovers on Thursday morning as the West Virginia University STEAM- (Science, Technology, Engineering, Arts and Mathematics) TACULAR program paid a visit.

item.title: New tattoo parlor cuts the ribbon in Morgantown
item.description: Cerberus Studios, Morgantown's newest tattoo parlor, welcomed the public to celebrate its grand opening on Thursday.

item.title: Sheriff identifies 2-year-old who died in Marion County auto-pedestrian incident
item.description: A two-year-old died on Tuesday after being struck by a vehicle in Marion County, Sheriff Roger Cunningham confirmed to 12 News.

item.title: Man who rammed his vehicle into Michigan synagogue was naturalized citizen from Lebanon, DHS says
item.description: An attacker armed with a rifle rammed his vehicle into one of the nation’s largest reform synagogues Thursday, driving through a hallway as security opened fire, fatally shooting him, authorities said.

item.title: Randy Moss shouts out West Virginia on Kelce brothers' podcast
item.description: West Virginians always love seeing the Mountain State get a shoutout on the national stage, including one from last week from a Hall of Famer.

item.title: Woman charged after child in her care was hospitalized for taking medicine in Fairmont
item.description: A woman has been charged in Marion County after a child in her care was hospitalized for taking medicine in a Fairmont home.

item.title: West Virginia House passes bill changing school days to school hours
item.description: Across decades in Mountain State education, the school year has been measured by 180 days, but on Thursday, the West Virginia House of Delegates passed a bill from the Senate that may change that.

item.title: Crews investigate 'suspicious' fire in Stonewood
item.description: A trailer in Stonewood has been considered a total loss after catching fire Thursday afternoon, but emergency crews say the cause has been deemed "suspicious."

item.title: Altercation with deputies ends with 2 arrests in Clarksburg
item.description: Two men from Maryland have been arrested and are facing charges after deputies say one of them tried to fight them after narcotics were found inside their vehicle.
